nodes.name: Browser gateway
nodes.responsibility: Where a pane's command arrives, already admitted and leased, and is carried out by the server's actions

nodes.name: Workhorse start
nodes.responsibility: Opens the one thread the server's link will name, with its instructions and both tool manifests, under a staged epoch operation

nodes.name: Thread link
nodes.responsibility: Which thread the Archboard server is bound to, whichever pane asks, and the refusal when a second binding disagrees

nodes.name: Thread tools
nodes.responsibility: The archboard_app manifest a workhorse is started with, pinned by its digest

nodes.name: Authored instructions
nodes.responsibility: The developer instructions a thread starts with, and the digest that proves them unchanged

nodes.name: Epoch ledger
nodes.responsibility: Which child generation owns which thread, on disk, with operations that commit, roll back or say the outcome is unknown

nodes.name: Codex session
nodes.responsibility: The reviewed methods a turn is actually sent on

nodes.name: Tell coordinator
nodes.responsibility: The archboard_coordinator tool a workhorse is started with: tell the coordinator one thing while it works

edges.label: a typed message: turn/start or turn/steer
classify and bind the server's thread
stage, commit or roll back the start
start a workhorse for the server
